notes: The change is focused, and its unit and end-to-end coverage specifically checks list creation, separation, filtering, URLs, and legacy migration. A key gap is that users with no existing lists always load a synthetic first list and never persist it until an edit; consequently, creating a list in a fresh app assigns it ID 1 and replaces the intended first list instead of adding to it. The implementation also labels an invalid list URL with an in-page message rather than handling it as a missing route.
